notes: Prose-heavy, few explicit markers. Stresses extraction from natural narration rather than 'Completed:' headers.

messages.content: I'm starting a Go microservice for order processing. Should talk gRPC to the inventory service.
Set up the module and the gRPC scaffolding. I created cmd/server/main.go, internal/order/service.go and proto/order.proto.
Let's use Postgres for orders. Keep it simple.
Decided: PostgreSQL for order storage. I've written internal/store/postgres.go with the connection pool.
Found it — the gRPC client had no dial timeout, so it blocked indefinitely. Fixed by adding a 5 second context timeout in internal/order/client.go. Tests pass now.
Working on exponential backoff in internal/order/client.go. Using cenkalti/backoff for it.
Actually drop that library, write it by hand, one less dependency
Switching from cenkalti/backoff to a hand-rolled retry loop. Removed the dependency from go.mod.
